643-1018-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-1018-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

7084-8249-8338.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3585-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 green Badger creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4770-5295-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

225-5531-5694-7874-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-5531-5694-7874-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, The Immortal Weapons and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-5531-5694-7874-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink The Immortal Weapons and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4365-4772-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Mondrak and Doubling Season.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
4365-4772-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

4934-5078-7729.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

3197-3641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-3641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2556-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and exiling Ephemerate.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-5256-5617.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1116-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1116-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Sek'Kuar and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

546-4613-5900-7236.easyPrerequisites: The total toughness of creatures you control excluding Towering Titan is at least 5.
546-4613-5900-7236.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Towering Titan. Towering Titan enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Towering Titan using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

6575-6684-7175.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

582-1409-1418.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve both Brazen Freebooter triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3967-5170-6132-6273.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2829-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2173-4050-4740-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
2173-4050-4740-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2173-4050-4740-5220.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

856-2173-5220-5231.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-5220-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-5220-5231.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

5708-6215.description:
At the beginning of each upkeep, Tombostone Stairwell's first ability triggers, causing each player to create a 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature card in their graveyard.
At the beginning of each end step, Tombstone Stairwell's second ability triggers, destroying all tokens created by it.
When the token(s) die, Vein Ripper triggers that many times, causing an opponent to lose twice that much life and you to gain twice that much life.
Repeat during each turn.

527-1247-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
527-1247-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3661-3967-5220-5683.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2281-2921-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

437-509-1781-2751-4131.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-1781-2751-4131.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, giving Sphinx's Disciple +1/+0 and causing it to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 6.

864-2639-3254-4871-5256.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2639-3254-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2639-3254-4871-5256.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Nethroi's power.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime's combined power.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Ooze's combined power.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Ooze's combined power.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

969-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
969-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1794-4424-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
1794-4424-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

1684-2178-2757-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
1684-2178-2757-5256.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Elemental, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar triggers, untapping Rakka Mar.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Elemental's power.
Repeat.

317-2292-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-2292-3197.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

751-1063-1742-3263.description:
Activate Skirga Familiar by discarding Shrieking Drake, adding {B}.
Oskar triggers, causing you to pay {1} to cast Shrieking Drake from your graveyard.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2499-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1308-1558-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites: Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1308-1558-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating two Treasure tokens, two Food tokens, and two Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.
